comment: Listening to him lecture is like watching da vinci paint a mural. Go to office hours. If you are taking a quiz and don't know the answer, it's probably 'Denmark'.

After 3 years of courses with Jeppe I can confidently say that he is one of the best profs at UR. He is brilliant and cares a lot about his students. His class teaches a different way of thinking and he challenges people to work hard. Overall 10/10

Hard but rewarding class. Participation and attendance matter. You have to do the readings in order to do well on daily quizzes. Jeppe is an awesome professor and you can tell he is very passionate about PPEL. Super accessible outside class/office hours and wants to see you do well!!
Jeppe is awesome. I've taken 3 classes with him and all of them were great. He makes class so interesting, and his super funny and genuine. Plus his Danish accent is nice.

Jeppe is the best professor I ever had at the University of Richmond. He also kept in contact with me after I graduated to make sure I am good and is one of the only professors I visited when I went back to Richmond. I highly recommend taking any course he teaches.
Jeppe is the best. Highly recommend his classes.

Jeppe is amazing. By far the best professor at Richmond. He is so caring and helpful, he also makes the subject matter really interesting. He's super funny and always has a good class planned. You can do well if you do the readings and take notes before writing the papers. No final or midterm and only 4 papers, love him so much.
